text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Bid Award Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office ending December 31, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.

The Bid Award Panel: 1. Elected the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, Finance and Treasury Services Designate as Vice Chair of the Bid Award Panel for a term of office starting January 12, 2022 and ending December 31, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.
